description:
A specific morpheme pattern was encountered within a word during reading. Morphemes are the smallest Meaningful units in Korean — suffixes, prefixes, postpositions, and inflectional endings that carry grammatical function or meaning.
This event tracks individual morpheme encounters for BKT parameter updates and spaced repetition scheduling. Each encounter is linked back to a sentence.read event via sourceId, establishing the full provenance chain: sentence.read → word.saved → morpheme.encountered.
Korean examples:
  -으려고 (purpose/ intention suffix: 먹으려고 = try to eat)
  -게 (purpose/result conjunction suffix)
  -(으)면 (conditional suffix)
  -지 (question/confirm suffix, also exclamatory)
  -는 (attributive/postposition suffix)
  -(으)ㄹ까 (speculative suffix)
  -다면서 (hearsay/confirm suffix)
  -(으)ㄹ래 (volitional/purpose suffix)
  -(으)면 좋겠다 (wish/regret suffix)
  -보다 (comparison/postposition suffix)

patternId.description: Unique identifier for the morpheme pattern. Should correspond to pattern codes in the SPEC morpheme taxonomy (e.g. EF_1, EF_2, suffix codes). Used for BKT parameter lookups and IRT calibration.

hostLemma.description: The dictionary form (lemma) of the word containing this morpheme. E.g., for "먹으려고" the hostLemma is "먹다" (eat).

hostEojeol.description: The full eojeol (space-separated word token) as it appeared in the sentence. E.g., "먹으려고" in "밥을 먹으려고 한다".

sourceId.description: Reference to the sentence.read event this encounter belongs to. Establishes provenance: sentence.read(sourceId=X) → morpheme.encountered(sourceId=X).

morphemePosition.description: 0-based index of the morpheme within the host eojeol. For agglutinative Korean, multiple morphemes can appear in sequence within one word. E.g., "먹으려고" → [0:먹, 1:으, 2:려고] — position 1 is the尊敬 suffix -으-.

structuralType.description: Structural category of the morpheme (from SPEC morpheme taxonomy): EF: endings (formal/informal markers, tense, mood) EP: postpositions (particles like -은, -을, -에서) ES: suffixes (lexical suffixes attached to nouns/verbs) ET: conjunctive suffixes (cause, purpose, condition) EV: verb suffixes EN: noun suffixes

segmentBoundaries.description: For compound morphemes, the segmentation points within the host eojeol. Format: comma-separated start:end offsets. E.g., "0:3,3:5,5:8" for "먹:으:려고".

encounterCount.description: Total number of times this pattern has been encountered across all reading sessions. Starts at 1 for first encounter. Persisted and incremented on each new encounter.

firstEncounteredAt.description: Timestamp of first encounter. Set once at first encounter and never changed.

lastEncounteredAt.description: Timestamp of most recent encounter of this pattern

contexts.description: Up to 5 recent sentence contexts where this morpheme was encountered. Allows pattern review and exemplar-based learning.

outcome.description: BKT-grade outcome of this morpheme encounter, aligned with tools.spec.event.lemma.encountered so the M-axis has the same clean per-encounter signal as the V/compound/grammar axes. auto_read/marked_known/reviewed_correct/mined -> Y=1; lookup/hover/click/marked_unknown/reviewed_again/reviewed_incorrect -> Y=0.

Y.description: Precomputed BKT-grade Y derived from outcome. Optional; consumers may re-derive from outcome via the canonical encounterOutcome mapping.

encounteredAt.description: UTC timestamp of this specific morpheme encounter. Distinct from firstEncounteredAt (first-ever) and lastEncounteredAt; this is the event time used for BKT sequencing and cross-app dedupe (eventId).

latencyMs.description: Milliseconds between the host eojeol becoming visible/available and this encounter being recorded. Optional direct latency signal for the CAS Automaticity (F) axis observation model (B9 Continuous Acquisition Spectrum Model S3.4/S5.1); when absent, F falls back to the coarser outcome-based proxy. See reference/017_continuous_acquisition_spectrum_hydration.md.

candidateAnalyses.description: Top-K bibim candidate analyses for the host eojeol when genuinely ambiguous, each carrying a raw candidatePatternId + freq (bibim's own enumerate-every-parse output). Optional; absent, or a single entry, means the eojeol was effectively unambiguous and patternId is the whole story. Enables the private enumerative/soft-evidence update (B9 S4.7) -- e.g. an eojeol like 안 that could be negation-adverb, noun, or a contracted modifier -- without requiring disambiguation before this event is emitted.

register.description: Register of the source content where this morpheme was encountered

difficulty.description: Pre-computed difficulty score for this morpheme pattern
